title: Day of Atonement
summary: The Day of Atonement was Israel’s solemn yearly day focused on cleansing, priestly mediation, and atonement before the Lord.
background: Leviticus 16 describes the high priest entering the Most Holy Place, sacrifices for sin, and the scapegoat imagery. Hebrews uses this background to magnify Christ’s priestly work.
teachingHelp: This topic gives one of the clearest bridges from tabernacle worship to Christ as the greater High Priest.
